scope: Read-only current public records and arithmetic. Known published outcomes disclosed in advance. No biological measurements, map refinement or wet-lab experiments.

yihu.interpretation: Product component has sulfonate plus two hydroxy groups, supporting DHPS identity, rather than GHB. Sequence confirms the published motif at residues118-131. This corroborates the assignment with known answer; it does not demonstrate native flux. PDB labels the dinucleotide NAD despite a title describing NADH, so its oxidation state is not newly established here.

yigl.protein_source: Klebsiella pneumoniae KPN_04322, UniProt A6TGK6; not E. coli YigL
yigl.interpretation: The reference structure used to orient docking contains HEPES/EPE and cryoprotectants, not PNP/PLP. It cannot serve as crystallographic evidence of vitamin substrate recognition by E. coli YigL. Published genotype/metabolite experiments supply the relevant evidence.

yihu_arithmetic.limitations: Approximately45,000 with the original paper molecular weight versus the later paper reported~42,000. Different preparations, NADH concentrations and rounded parameters prevent a matched-condition precision claim; monomer-active-site normalization assumed. The qualitative disparity is the useful result.
